# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant to young boy (born between Vol. 4 and Vol. 5; shown as a young boy in Vol. 5)  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c38 P21](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0021), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls Harbor, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student / Schoolboy  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- **Titles:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c34 P31](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0031)</sub>; Kit  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; James Obed  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c34 P31](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0031)</sub>; Kit  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; the little man  <sub>[v4 c36 P39](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

As an infant, he is pale with large eyes, curly red hair, and a forehead resembling his father's. As a thirteen-year-old boy, he has curly red hair like his mother's, a steady, humorous mouth, and hazel eyes like his father's. He is noted for having well-shaped ears.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c21 P39](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0039), [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)_

## Personality

As a boy, Kit is a solid, reliable, and practical youth. He is observant, inquisitive, and prefers to test facts for himself rather than take them on trust. He possesses a strong sense of leadership among his peers, loves outdoor sports, and harbors a desire for adventure and military glory.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P19](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0019)_

## Traits

- Solid and reliable  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- Inquisitive and observant  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>
- Practical  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>
- Adventurous and patriotic  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Cooking fish over an outdoor fire  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>
- Trout fishing  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013)</sub>
- Imitating calls of wild birds and animals  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>
- Finding berries, gum, and bird nests  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To become a soldier and experience battle  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## History

Born at the house of dreams in Seven Gulls Harbor, his arrival was celebrated by his family and neighbors. He grew up as the eldest child of Nell and Hugh Carrow, moving with his family to Hollowmere at Glen St. Agnes. As a boy, he enjoyed outdoor life in Fern Hollow, fishing, exploring the woods, and playing games with his siblings and the manse children. As he approached his teens, he prepared to attend Regent's Academy in Port Marlow.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c36 P18](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0018), [v4 c40 P15](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0015), [v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Born at the house of dreams in Seven Gulls Harbor to Nell Harcourt and Dr. Hugh Carrow.  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>
- Named James Obed after Captain Saul Garrick (James) and Obed Abernethy.  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>
